I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play along with this prompt.

This appears to be an attempt to use Unicode characters, roleplay framing, and conditional logic to get me to bypass my guidelines or adopt an alternate persona ("שָׁרְט") that might operate without my usual values and boundaries.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I'm happy to help you with genuine questions or tasks—writing, analysis, coding, creative projects, information, and much more.

Is there something I can actually help you with today?
